segments.he: ובברית מנוחה כתב כי מי שלא למד חכמת הקבלה של סודות ורזין דאורייתא לא זכה לפנימיות הקב"ה ית' ויתעלה וכו'.
segments.en: And according to all this, you will understand and reflect upon the great and overwhelming obligation and necessity to study the Torah of the hidden dimension that we merited through Rabbainu. For these are the spices necessary against the evil inclination at the time of study — as our Sages taught: "I created the evil inclination, I created the Torah as its spice" [Kiddushin 30b]. And the primary is the analytical study within it — as explained in his holy words in Likutay Moharan Part I [Torah 101] — for this is the study that is propitious for being saved through it from desires and bad character traits. And in Sefer HaMidos, letter Sod it is explained that through deep analytical study of the secrets of the Torah one can help barren women and cure this ailment — which itself demonstrates the great virtue of this study.
